definitions.explanation: The act of forming an opinion or making a decision after careful consideration of the facts.

examples.japanese: {正|ただ}しい{判断|はんだん}をすることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to make the right judgment.

examples.japanese: {状況|じょうきょう}を{見|み}て{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: I'll make a decision after seeing the situation.

examples.japanese: {判断|はんだん}を{誤|あやま}った。

notes:
USAGE: {判断|はんだん} refers to forming conclusions or making decisions based on reasoning and evidence.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{判断|はんだん}する (to judge, to decide)
・{判断|はんだん}を{下|くだ}す (to make a judgment)
・{判断|はんだん}を{誤|あやま}る (to misjudge)
・{判断|はんだん}に{迷|まよ}う (to be uncertain in judgment)
・{判断|はんだん}に{任|まか}せる (to leave to someone's judgment)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{判断力|はんだんりょく} (judgment ability)
・{判断|はんだん}{基準|きじゅん} (criteria for judgment)
・{判断|はんだん}{材料|ざいりょう} (grounds for judgment)
・{自己|じこ}{判断|はんだん} (self-judgment)
・{価値|かち}{判断|はんだん} (value judgment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{決断|けつだん} - decision (emphasizes resolve)
・{決定|けってい} - decision (official/final)
・{裁判|さいばん} - trial, legal judgment
